question: Does a model's rank at three, six or twelve training people survive at eighteen? What changes with more people at fixed example count, more examples at fixed people, additional sensors, or a wider network?
source: Peterson and Ferris, OpenNeuro ds003739 1.0.3, visual rotation standing and walking. Reuse the paired-study qualified archives and original splitting, measurement, timing and control definitions. 18 development people, 6 previously examined comparison people. Other six reserve participants excluded from every stage.
units: Online prediction is outside the design. Each rotation contributes one 625 ms pre-cutoff history and measured 125 ms future. Inputs are three scalp sites (availability flags retained), eight muscle voltages, three-axis sacrum position, four deterministic projections of that same position, posture and direction. Original filtering is offline and eligibility depended in part on valid outcomes. No invented observations, interpolation across people or random event test split. Decoding four forecast marker knots into 32 times follows the original linear interpolation.
orders: For each seed sort the 18 development source IDs by SHA256 of ASCII {seed}|{source_id}, ascending digest bytes. Take nested prefixes without inspecting any outcomes. Orders are not independent cohorts. Combine equal-weight per-order results; at 18 people identical subsets and fits count once.
design: At every donor size, (a) retain all eligible windows for those people and (b) select exactly 432 distinct windows. For the latter take 432/(4*n) windows per person, posture and direction. In each cell sort by SHA256 of ASCII 17413|{source_id}|{integer_posture}|{signed_direction_decimal_no_plus}|{integer_event_ordinal}, ascending digest bytes. Fixed order independent of all signals and outcomes. At 18 people also score 864, 1728 and 3456 windows using the same nested cell order. All training subsets returned in ascending original archive row order. The fixed 432-row series replaces windows when adding people, so training rows are only nested in the all-available donor and fixed-people example series.
networks: Primary ranking: paired and early mixing at widths 8,16,32. Shared inherited Fusion.forward, equal widths and counts for each topology. Replace projection/branch width 16 by w and fusion width 32 by 2w. Input and output unchanged. Controls at width 16 use separately fitted original paired models with scalp values masked, electrical values (scalp and EMG) masked or mechanics (position and derived projections) masked. Keep availability flags, posture and direction in each. Mask after standardizing according to original definition. Untrained previous-RMS + stationary and previous-RMS + 32-sample constant-velocity baselines on all held people. Deterministic physics is a representation, not an additional instrument.
fit: Use the original fixed AdamW schedule: 384 steps, batch 128 sampled with replacement, same initial weight draw for matched widths and training index sequence per seed, original equal-cell/equal-person sampling, two equally weighted smooth-L1 standardized target losses. Subset-specific standardization from training only, no donor adaptation, no early stopping or tuning. At full 18 all windows reuse previously qualified exact 16-wide fitted states and population scales. Train remaining models fresh. Optimize workflow only from source-equivalent CPU1/CPU2/GPU prefix evidence and development-only checks. No outcome-based model selection. Fix all weights and subset hashes before scoring assessment.
scores: Use original event muscle mean absolute voltage error (microvolts), mean 32-sample 3D marker path distance (mm) and endpoint distance (mm). Equal weight to each direction in posture and each posture/person; summarize both postures together, provide separate posture summaries. Six historical people always identical, as are all their eligible rows. Average errors (not predictions) across optimization seeds then donor orders. Primary ranking endpoints muscle and mean path separately. Per-person aggregate errors, per-fit/seed variation and order variation will be retained. Bootstrap six people jointly with replacement, 10000 draws, seed 431, paired differences and 2.5/97.5 percentiles, exploratory conditional on training sets. No independence credited to events, orders or fit seeds.
rank_analysis: For each primary endpoint and all-available and matched-432 regimes compare six learned full-input models at each smaller level to 18 in the same regime. Compute Kendall tau-a over 15 distinct pairs (ties contribute zero), number of reversed paired comparisons, and top-choice persistence, from order-averaged scores and each order's scores separately. Also report contrasts of sources, capacity and training-size at the person level. Descriptive only, including separate standing/walking scores. No prospective data or performance threshold inferred.
scale_forecast: Backtest numeric errors at the observed 18-person endpoint in the all-available series for each of six primary models and each endpoint. Fit only order-averaged errors at 3,6,12 people. Compare a flat forecast (12-person value) to e(n)=b+a/sqrt(n) with b,a>=0 using unweighted least squares. Report predictions, actuals, errors and mean absolute errors across six configurations separately per outcome. This is a retrospective forecast at an unseen training size on the same evaluation people, with an already-known historical full-width result. Do not fit a free exponent, infer a true irreducible floor or predict beyond observed size. Only four sizes in one study and fixed optimization budget.
privacy: Share source code, protocol and aggregate errors. Keep event arrays, private subset manifests, parameters and assessment identities outside public products. Independently reconstructable through the pinned paired study.
fit_arithmetic: NumPy scales and decoding; PyTorch highest float32 matrix precision, each worker intra/inter-op, BLAS and OpenMP 1. Up to four independent processes; no competing local job is modified. CPU, memory pressure and elapsed time are observational. An unavailable energy or external compute bill stays unknown.
